sources.title: Census of India 2011 District Census Handbook: village amenities (Tamil Nadu village release)
sources.publisher: Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner, India
sources.license: Government of India publication, cited with attribution

provenance.note: Census 2011 DCHB village amenities for 20 Gram Panchayats in ODDANCHATRAM block: land use and irrigation-by-source areas summed over each Panchayat's bound Census villages (villages[] carries the source rows), and drinking-water source availability combined per Panchayat. Reference year 2009 for the village tables; a historical baseline, not current service.

conventions.measures: hectares, summed over constituent villages; null when no village states the figure
conventions.availability: available when any constituent village reports the source; not-available only when every village does; otherwise not-stated
conventions.seasonal: sourceTypesLostInSummer lists sources reported for the year but not for April to September - 2009 seasonality, not present reliability
conventions.bindings: a Panchayat with no Census binding in the directory has no record here
